name: Beef
effect: North specialty. Taipei beef-noodle soul; Tainan dawn beef soup. Marquee-held (few, premium vendors).
art_note: Braised beef-shank slice — deep red silhouette

name: Pork Belly
effect: North specialty. The comfort-food protein — bao, braises, dumplings. Capped at 5 vendors (was the runaway workhorse).
art_note: Cross-section slab of striped pork belly

name: Chicken
effect: North specialty. Fried cutlets, karaage burgers, Chiayi turkey rice, maqaw soup.

name: Egg
effect: North specialty. Egg crepes, oyster omelette, breakfast-shop 加蛋.
art_note: A cracked egg with a bright yolk

name: Tea
effect: Central specialty. Nantou/Lugu oolong, Sun Moon Lake black tea, the leaf behind bubble tea. Central's workhorse.

name: Tapioca Pearls
effect: Central specialty. Chewy tapioca born in Taichung tea shops. Now demanded across bubble tea, Dongding tea house, ba-wan.
art_note: Cluster of dark round tapioca pearls

name: Oysters
effect: South specialty. Tainan & Chiayi 東石 tidal-flat oyster farms. Now a real destination — 4 vendors.
art_note: Plump shucked oyster on the half shell

name: Milkfish
effect: South specialty. Tainan's farmed milkfish. Now demanded across congee, shrimp roll, beef soup.

name: Rice
effect: East specialty. Premium Chishang/Guanshan valley rice. Capped at 4 vendors (was over-demanded).
art_note: Bowl of glossy short-grain rice with a single ear of grain

name: Mountain Greens
effect: East specialty. Mountain & Indigenous produce — bird's-nest fern, chayote shoots, maqaw.
art_note: Bundle of leafy fern and chayote-vine shoots

name: Pantry
effect: UNLIMITED open supply — the convenience store, available in every region. Noodles, flour, starch, seasoning, broth abstracted to one flexible token. Never discounted, always in stock (print ~30, restock as needed).
